title: Add the required `// keepAlive:` justification comment to Sacred Time's 6 keepAlive providers

evidence.quote:
@Riverpod(keepAlive: true)
LocationService locationService(Ref ref) => const LocationService();

why: coding-standards.md SM-6 requires every keepAlive: true to carry an inline // keepAlive: comment; these 6 declarations (cities_provider.dart:7, sacred_location_provider.dart:12/17/123, sacred_windows_provider.dart:13/33) have nearby doc comments explaining rationale but none use the required tag, so a future audit grep for the literal marker (as SM-6's own Enforce plan proposes) would still flag all 6 as unjustified even though they are reasoned. This mirrors a repo-wide gap (only ~6/86 keepAlive sites in lib/ use the tag), not something unique to this feature.
recommendation: Prefix each keepAlive declaration's existing rationale with the literal `// keepAlive: ...` tag so the future audit grep can find it.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 keepAlive providers in this batch carry a // keepAlive:-prefixed comment
A grep for 'keepAlive: true' paired with a check for the tag on the preceding line finds no gaps in this feature

corrections: 2 of the 6 cited sites (cities_provider.dart:7 citiesRepository, sacred_location_provider.dart:12 locationService) have no preceding doc comment whatsoever, so the recommendation to 'prefix each keepAlive declaration's existing rationale' doesn't apply to them — new rationale would need to be written, not just tagged.
